message:
We recently had a family meeting to talk about our emergency plans, and let me tell you, it was quite the experience! Our kids had a lot of questions, and some giggles, as we tried to explain why having a go-bag is important. 

At one point, our youngest asked if we could put in some of their favorite snacks, which led to a hilarious debate about what qualifies as an essential item. 🍿

It reminded us that preparedness doesn’t have to be serious all the time. Making it a family affair helps everyone feel involved and ready. 

What’s your favorite way to engage your kids in preparedness?
